title: Best practical Ds solver with theorem-backed certificate
statement: DS19 closes the deployment-facing question by reduction. For d_psi=1 the tilt-DP construction gives a valid generalized bracket p^+<=g^+<=d and a regular in-bin bracket p_reg<=g_reg<=d, with exact closure iff a concrete DP-optimal labeling satisfies the tilt normal equation. Strong duality is false by an exact order-one N=4 counterexample and, support-minimally, by an exact N=3, K=2 counterexample. Fixed-tilt exact DP evaluation (O(KN) after sorting, ties tolerated), polynomial certified-epsilon dual minimization, exact polynomial-bit minimization at d_lambda=1 for every K, and arithmetic-polynomial exact minimization for fixed d_lambda>=2 (Toledo 1993) are established; exact polynomial bit complexity for fixed d_lambda>=2 with variable K, and any exact statement for variable d_lambda, is isolated as OPEN-DS-TILT-DUAL-EXACT-COMPLEXITY. On the exact DS18 law, the beta-zero interval DP is Delta-consistent almost surely and inherits the audited value-to-disagreement transfer, but not exchange stability, local-ascent selection, or compile authorization. For d_psi>1 the matrix-tilt outer map need not even be quasiconvex. The observable compile decision is therefore: an exhibited regular saddle certifies finite globality; an open bracket reports a bounded interval; projected efficient-score compilation remains the currently established unconditional projected route; a DS14 companion requires all audited sequence hypotheses; otherwise refuse.
assumptions: Tier A certificate: d_psi=1, d_lambda>=1, positive rational finite weights, exact-K nonempty cells, raw uncentered score rows
the generalized DS11 pseudo-inverse and ordinary DS9 in-bin comparison domains are reported separately
the exact DS18 Delta-consistency corollary uses only the named bounded law, K=3, beta=0, iid equal weights, and exact scores

independently audited 2 Sep 2026 (AUDIT-DS-PRACTICAL-CERTIFIED-SOLVER): verified with hardened assumptions; the audit itself authorizes no src or public compile surface, which remains governed by DS-PROFILED-COMPILE-CERTIFICATE
a reported open bracket is not a gap certificate (CE-DS-TILT-DUAL-TIE-MASK-001), and the DP-active primal p^+ can sit strictly below g^+

proof_location.section: DS19. The tilt-DP bracket: weak certification, an order-one gap, and a value-consistent DS18 primal

role: reduced Tier A verdict answering P1's deployment question, independently audited, isolating the remaining exact-complexity question in P7

The Tier B outer map is nonquasiconvex. No generic gate root, local optimizer terminal, measured nuisance floor, open bracket, or audit verdict authorizes compilation.
